title: Take a weapon
desc: Take a weapon from the rack; it is equipped at once. Sword, dagger and hammer leave the off hand free for the shield; the spear needs both hands.

title: Pick a stance
desc: A stance adds modifiers to your fighting while it is held. Each stance’s modifiers are listed under the buttons. Neutral has none.

title: Leave the cell
desc: Travel is done on the map. Select the marked ❓ pin in the corridor to open its card, then select the pin again to walk there; the road takes 2 s.

title: Fight the Cell Slime
desc: Start ⚔️ Fight the Cell Slime. You swing each time your action bar fills; the slime hits for exactly 1.

title: Go to the Field
desc: Kills pay XP and roll the monster’s loot; items and materials go to the Equipment tab. Select the marked ❓ pin in the yard, then select it again to walk there (3 s).

title: Pick a spell
desc: Pick a one-word arcane spell; it costs 2 mana. Taking it raises Intelligence to 2, and mana is 1 per point of Intelligence.

title: Cast it
desc: Start ⚔️ Fight in the Field and win once. A prepared spell casts itself on a swing when you have the mana.

title: Go to the Gate
desc: Select the marked ❓ pin on the gate, then select it again to walk there (3 s). Past the Gate is Threshold, the city at the Foot of the Ascent.

title: Leave floor 0
desc: Select → Threshold beside the Gate (3 s); the road is one-way and floor 0 closes behind you. The Warden of the Foot gives the next step, the floor 1 quest The First Ascent.
